name: phone_call
description: 📞 Make phone calls, call someone, ring, dial a number. Use when user says 'call my mom', 'call boss', 'phone Andrew', 'dial +1555...', 'ring my friend', or gives a business phone number to call. Pass an unsaved number directly as recipient; no name or saved contact is required. Jarvis calls on your behalf via Vapi.ai and reports the result. Actions: 'call' (make a phone call), 'status' (check result - 'what happened on that call?'), 'list' (recent calls), 'contacts' (save/list phone numbers). Opted-in Web calls can use the remote background worker; status/list/contacts remain foreground. Otherwise server configuration controls waiting. Background progress reports call phases, not conversation text. Completed transcripts and available recordings save to Stash; audio Stash references use the existing player. Transcript saving to Canvas is automatic on observed completion; check saved_to_canvas. Missing audio is nonfatal; report audio_status/audio_error honestly. A pending call or delayed transcript should be inspected with 'status', not redialed. Recording URLs require authenticated backend retrieval.

action.description: Action: 'call' to make a phone call, 'status' to check a call's result, 'list' to see recent calls, 'contacts' to manage contacts

recipient.description: Who to call: a saved contact name (e.g., 'Boss', 'Andrew') or a phone number supplied for this call. Pass unsaved business or personal numbers directly here; a name and contact creation are unnecessary. US area-code numbers default to +1; use +countrycode for other countries.

task.description: What should Jarvis accomplish on the call? Be specific about the objective. E.g., 'Ask if he wants to see Gladiator II at the 9pm showing tonight and confirm'

context.description: Additional context to help Jarvis on the call. E.g., movie details, previous conversation summary, etc.

persona.description: Persona/style for generated assistants. Omit to use the server's configured default. 'default' is Jarvis (male), 'professional' is formal James (butler-style), 'casual' is relaxed Jay, 'female' is friendly Samantha. A saved assistant uses its own persona.

wait.description: DEPRECATED - DO NOT USE. Wait behavior is controlled by server config. This parameter is ignored.

add_name.description: Name for adding a new contact (with 'contacts' action)

add_number.description: Phone number for adding a new contact (with 'contacts' action)
